name: Tsukishiro Ayato
source:
[spoiler]Yoshimasa's only son and the heir of Mother. His appearance and intelligence were genetically modified, but his hobbies and personality were shaped by his environment. He has synesthesia that allows him to sense the flavor of bodily fluids. He senses the taste of his late mother, Sachertorte, in Sora's fluids. [/spoiler]
